applicabilityBasis.summary: Tenbin AssetCo (BVI) SPC Ltd. issues tMXN as a Mexican peso-denominated unsecured debt-note (UCC Article 12 CER) entitling eligible KYC-approved holders to repayment of the U.S. dollar value of one Mexican peso at the spot price, settled in approved stablecoins such as USDC rather than national fiat currency. Binding Terms of Use exclude U.S. Persons from minting, redeeming, or holding interest-bearing tokens and disclaim bank-deposit status. Whether a BVI SPC synthetic FX debt-note redeemable in stablecoins satisfies the GENIUS Act section 2(22) fixed monetary-value payment-stablecoin definition remains unresolved.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-11-27. Tenbin Foundation Terms of Use (updated July 13, 2026) and Legal docs identify Tenbin AssetCo (BVI) SPC Ltd. (owned by Tenbin Foundation, a Cayman Islands foundation company) acting for a segregated portfolio as the tMXN issuer. U.S. Persons are excluded from minting and redeeming under Tenbin's Geographic Restrictions and Terms of Use; U.S. geo-blocking is an issuer eligibility restriction rather than a GENIUS DASP prohibition while the Act remains pre-effective. Tenbin publishes a live transparency dashboard and an aggregated Base Chainlink PoR feed covering all assets' off-chain reserves together, plus KYC-gated USDC redemption terms, but no monthly independent CPA reserve attestation is published yet. Authorization, pathway, foreign exception, and enforcement findings are dated bounded public-evidence negatives as of 2026-11-27.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-11-27, the checked OCC materials, Federal Register exact-term searches, FinCEN enforcement index, and primary Tenbin legal disclosures disclosed no public GENIUS Act permitted payment stablecoin issuer approval, state qualification, official application, registered foreign exception, or token-specific enforcement action naming Tenbin AssetCo (BVI) SPC Ltd., Tenbin Foundation, or tMXN. This is a dated bounded public-evidence finding and does not rule out confidential filings.
